name: BrowserPod
tagline: BrowserPod is a browser-based virtual machine
description: BrowserPod is a browser-based virtual machine. Its API provides a lightweight Linux kernel, replacing expensive and complex cloud infrastructure by delegating server processes to the client's browser via WebAssembly. Developers use BrowserPod to run sandboxes for AI code, create developer tools and documentation without the cloud compute, and as part of wider enterprise transformation programs aiming to reduce their cloud costs and dependencies.
